name: custbill-header-status-by-batch
evidence: reports.py STATUS_SQL (services/legacy-billing/app/reports.py:42-53, ap-6167f9171f): invoice_header count and total_amt per status, replayed for every batch_no; the CODES label join is dropped (codes is another unit) so status_cd stays numeric
source_sql: SELECT batch_no AS "batchNo", status_cd AS "statusCd", COUNT(*) AS "invoiceCount", NVL(SUM(total_amt), 0) AS "headerTotalAmt" FROM invoice_header GROUP BY batch_no, status_cd

name: custbill-lines-by-batch-type
evidence: reports.py LINE_SQL (services/legacy-billing/app/reports.py:55-81, ap-89c88ad4c6): line count, amount, tax and invoices touched per (batch_no, line_type_cd), on invoice_line alone (the header join is batch-scoped, not per parent — 03_access_review check 4)
source_sql: SELECT batch_no AS "batchNo", line_type_cd AS "lineTypeCd", COUNT(*) AS "lineCount", NVL(SUM(amount), 0) AS "lineAmount", NVL(SUM(tax_amt), 0) AS "lineTax", COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS "invoicesTouched" FROM invoice_line GROUP BY batch_no, line_type_cd

name: custbill-ghost-lines
evidence: OPERATIONS_HANDBOOK 4.2 'ghost lines' / d-orphan-il-invoice (data_profile pointer_resolve:INVOICE_LINE.INVOICE_ID->INVOICE_HEADER unresolved=37): lines whose INVOICE_ID resolves to no header must be loaded verbatim, never dropped
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "ghostLines" FROM invoice_line l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_header h WHERE h.invoice_id = l.invoice_id)
